description: Round a batch of time entries to billing increments the way a law office bills them. Send each entry's matter code, timekeeper code and time (minutes or hours), with an optional hourly rate; choose the increment (0.1 hour = 6 minutes by default, or 0.05, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5 or 1 hour) and the rounding (up by default, nearest or down). Each entry is rounded on its own. Get back every entry's billed hours and the minutes rounding added or took away, totals by matter and by timekeeper, the rounding effect in hours, percent and money, and the entries where rounding at least doubled the time actually worked. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/billing-increments). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

entries.description: Time entries (up to 200). No narratives: send codes and time only.

hours.description: Time worked in hours (up to 4 decimals). Send minutes or hours.

matter.description: Matter code with at least one digit (your billing system's matter number, such as M-1042 or 2026-0042; up to 8 digits in a row, letters only as abbreviations up to 4), not a client name.

minutes.description: Time worked in minutes (up to 2 decimals). Send minutes or hours.

rate.description: Optional hourly rate for this entry, for the money effect.

timekeeper.description: Timekeeper code (TK07, or initials up to 4 letters), not a name.

increment_hours.description: Billing increment in hours: 0.1 (6 minutes, default), 0.05 (3), 0.2 (12), 0.25 (15), 0.5 (30) or 1 (60).

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'October prebill' (your own text, echoed; not a client name).

rounding.description: up (default): to the next increment unless already on one. nearest: half an increment or more goes up. down: drop the part below an increment.

title: Time Entry Billing Increments
